summary: Finalized implementation plan and staged checklist for RailForge Consist v0.2.0-beta.1 incorporating code-level proof and baseline measurements of the existing eager scanner, benchmarked concurrency (2, 4, and 8 workers), multi-factor cache validation, metadata-only Stage B asset indexing (zero asset-content reads), separated static vs. continuous FreightAnim handling, clearly labelled estimated consist physics vs. parsed source properties, standard Windows native title bar for v0.2, and prioritised stage-by-stage execution order.
